evidence.detail: Static initialization loads runescape.ttf, runescape_small.ttf and runescape_bold.ttf through Class.getResourceAsStream, creates/derives 16pt AWT fonts, registers them with GraphicsEnvironment and stores normalized StyleContext fonts.
The class owns five static Font instances and exposes them through five zero-argument static getters; the remaining two entries are 16pt Dialog plain/bold fallbacks.

FontFormatException is converted to RuntimeException('Font loaded, but format incorrect.') and IOException to RuntimeException('Font file not found.'), proving this class owns bundled-font initialization rather than arbitrary typography styling.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the launcher/UI bundled RuneScape font registry.
